hero_copy.label: Hero introduction
hero_copy.value: I'm Haley Reeder, an instructional designer focused on sales and partner enablement for complex products. I design the learning experience and can also work with LMS operations, reporting, automation, AI evaluation, or custom development when the project needs it.

featured_intro.label: Featured work introduction
featured_intro.value: The portfolio is organized around instructional design, AI evaluation, LMS administration, and the systems and workflows that support learning.

hero_title.label: Experience heading
hero_title.value: From classroom teaching to enterprise enablement

hero_intro_primary.label: Experience summary
hero_intro_primary.value: I started as a high-school teacher and now design enterprise learning for sales and partner audiences. My work also includes LMS administration, AI evaluation, multimedia production, automation, and reporting when those capabilities support the learning solution.

thread_heading.label: Workflow comparison heading
thread_heading.value: How I adapt the work to the learning need

hero_intro.label: Projects hero introduction
hero_intro.value: Explore instructional design, AI training and evaluation, LMS administration, and the systems and workflows that support learning development, delivery, measurement, and maintenance.

family_intro.label: Project types introduction
family_intro.value: Each area shows a different part of how I design, build, evaluate, operate, and improve learning experiences.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I design learning from needs analysis through launch and maintenance. Depending on the problem, that can mean eLearning, multimedia, interactive practice, microlearning, live facilitation, assessments, or performance tools.

overview_heading.label: Overview heading
overview_heading.value: Different learning products need different design workflows.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: I start with the performance need, audience, source content, constraints, and how the learner will use the solution. Then I choose the format and level of build effort that fit the job.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: The work changes by deliverable, but I keep the same closed loop: define the design philosophy, plan the experience, build it efficiently, and make sure feedback, ownership, and updates are part of the solution.

examples_intro.label: Examples introduction
examples_intro.value: Current portfolio examples focus on interactive learning, multimedia production, and eLearning and learning pathways.

hero_intro_primary.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro_primary.value: I evaluate AI-generated work against task requirements, source evidence, and quality standards rather than surface fluency alone.

hero_intro_secondary.label: Hero supporting paragraph
hero_intro_secondary.value: My work includes structured evaluation, analytical review, error detection, feedback writing, quality assurance, and testing AI within professional learning workflows.

overview_heading.label: Overview heading
overview_heading.value: Evaluation starts with requirements and evidence

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: A polished response can still be inaccurate, incomplete, unsupported, or misaligned with the task.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: I define the task, audience, source material, and success criteria before evaluating accuracy, completeness, instruction adherence, consistency, and usability.

overview_body_three.label: Overview paragraph 3
overview_body_three.value: I separate material quality issues from stylistic preference and focus feedback on problems that affect correctness, usefulness, or reliability.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I design the processes around learning work as carefully as the learning itself, from design and development workflows to LMS operations, AI integration, automation, reporting, and long-term content ownership.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: I use documented workflows to make design decisions, handoffs, reviews, and development easier to follow and repeat.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: I also automate repetitive work, connect content with LMS and reporting systems, and use AI where it improves speed or quality without removing review and ownership.

overview_body_three.label: Overview paragraph 3
overview_body_three.value: Documentation, versioning, analytics, and clear ownership keep learning products maintainable after launch and create evidence for continuous improvement.

areas_intro.label: Workflow areas introduction
areas_intro.value: Explore learning design, learning development, work automation, AI integration, LMS and content operations, and documentation and continuous improvement.
